name: E07_4_firespitter_whelp_each_opponent_takes_one
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature or Dragon spell, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.' A three-player game. Seat 0 casts Opt (an instant): each of its two opponents, seats 1 and 2, takes 1 damage (19 each). Seat 0 takes none.
